show.description: After a wealthy businessman dies in a mysterious car accident, his grieving family becomes the center of suspicion. As a determined police officer and an insurance investigator dig deeper, hidden secrets and a carefully planned deception begin to surface, revealing that the truth behind the tragedy may be far more dangerous than it appears.
